_note: Campus life at Bullworth Academy (UBullyCampusSubsystem). Behaviour, times and numbers are from the original's scripts/data where they exist (sources per block, docs/re-notes/campus-life.md); values marked _approx are ours where the rule is engine-side (Bully.exe, not readable). Install-derived data (trigger points, voices, speech takes, the bell) come from `python3 -m tools.importers campus` into imported/ (git-ignored); names below refer to it. No game text or audio is in this file.

schedule._src: periods: install Config/timeCycl.dat (MORNING 7, FIRST_CLASS 9, LUNCH_TIME 12, SECOND_CLASS 13, AFTERNOON 16, EVENING 21, BED_TIME 23). The classes END at 11:30 and 15:30: AreaScripts/MainMap.lua + SchoolHallways.lua start the class spawners (students out of the classrooms) at 11:30 and 15:30 and the class dockers (students into the school, 80 % running) at 8:45 and 12:45; timeCycl.dat's 12/16 are the HUD clock arcs. Curfew 23:00-07:00: STimeCycle.lua F_CurfewDefaultRules. Skipping punishment: SGlFunc.lua gSkippingPunishmentThresholds over the 5-class window of SInitGl.lua shared.gClassesSkipped, applied at F_StartClass. Truancy only after 1_02C (main.lua F_PlayerBusted has no class consequence before it; 1_02C is the first-class tutorial). Hangout spawners stop ~22:30 (15:30 + 420 min); the school empties at 18:45 (SchoolHallways.lua F_UpdateSpawnerTimer).
schedule._late_after_approx: the 'late for class' moment is engine-side; two game minutes after the bell is ours

trouble._src: Punishment points (PlayerSetPunishmentPoints): 1_02B forces 200 (min 199 until hidden, docs/re-notes/ch1/1_02B); 3_01A summons cops at 300; 2_S06/4_01 add 200 for big offences; F_AttendedClass zeroes the meter; a bust zeroes it (main.lua). The per-offence amounts, the chase line and the drain rate are engine-side: _approx.

prefects._src: vision: install Config/dat/pedstats.dat STAT_PF_BASIC_A (vision yaw 100 deg total, 12 m); run speed: Config/dat/ped.dat PREFECT run 6.0 m/s (we run 5.6 so a sprinting Jimmy, 8 m/s, can get away). Patrol routes: DAT PrefectsSchoolGround / PrefectsMainBuilding (AreaScripts MainMap.lua / SchoolHallways.lua PatrolPathInit). Bust radius / give-up: _approx.

factions._src: SFaction.lua F_MissionFactionChanges: per faction the first completed mission in the list sets its default attitude toward the player (0 Abhor, 1 Averse, 2 Dispassionate, 3 Dig, 4 Adore; Chapter 1-2 rows kept). Respect (campaign, SetFactionRespect values: 1_01 sets bullies 25 / nerds, preps, greasers, jocks 50 / dropouts 0) shifts it one step at the extremes (_approx: the engine's respect -> attitude curve is not in the scripts).
factions._start_respect_src: 1_01.lua SetFactionRespect(11, 25) (1, 50) (5, 50) (4, 50) (2, 50) (3, 0): seeded when day_one (our 1_01) passes on a fresh game

_cast_note: Fallback faction / voice / aggression per model; `python3 -m tools.importers campus` replaces them with the install's Objects/default.ide ped type + N_<name> voice and the pedstats.dat aggression. Aggression < 15 = runs when hit (generic students, girls), >= 50 = picks fights at Abhor and backs up faction mates.
_spawns_note: The campus cast beyond Config/AmbientLoops.json (whose loop walkers are adopted as the between-classes crowd on the front lawn). hangout = a faction hangout POI point of DAT tschool_hangouts (file/poi#index; dx/dy spread the clique); path = a patrol path of the trigger files. zone: grounds (outdoor, docks into the school front doors) or halls (the main building, docks into the classroom doors). A model that is not imported here is skipped.

places._src: DAT tschool_doors (outdoor school doors the class dockers/spawners use, MainMap.lua SchoolGroundsSpawners kind=class), ischool_doors (classroom doors, SchoolHallways.lua SchoolSpawnTable), Population/SchoolArea (the school-grounds volume), SP_School_Hallways (the main building), PriOffice/POfficeExclude, PrincipalCutscene PRIOFF_SPAWN / PRIOFF_OUTSIDE (PriOff.lua), School_Exterior/Schoolbell.
places._fallback_note: Used when the trigger import is absent (clean clone): the hand-placed main-door spots of tools/ue/door_links.json and a box around the ambient loops.

speech._src: Speech.lst ambient lines `<Speaker>_<CODE>_v<k>`. Context codes: what each code is was worked out from the event names the scripts request (SoundPlayAmbientSpeechEvent: GREET, BUMP_RUDE, FIGHT_INITIATE, CONVERSATION_GOSSIP, WARNING_TRESPASSING, WARNING_COMING_TO_CATCH, CHASE, BUSTING_JIMMY, ...; Scripts.img also names FIGHT_WATCH, CONVERSATION_QUESTION(_REPLY), CONVERSATION_NEGATIVE_PERSONAL/REPLY, SEE_SOMETHING_CRAP, RESPONSE_GREET_FRIENDLY, WARNING_MINOR_INFRACTION) and checked by ear on a sample (docs/re-notes/campus-life.md has the table). Lecture: PriOff.lua PRINCIPAL_LECTURING ids -> Crabble_PLECT_<id> (id = file number, inferred).

performance._note: walkers farther than dormant_beyond_m from Jimmy freeze and hide (no tick); the halls and the lawn are ~870 m apart, so only one half of the cast runs at a time
